inventorySettings.policy_block_all: Stop operations when stock runs out, for all products

inventorySettings.allow_warning: Allowing negative stock does double damage: the inventory account (1140) ends up with a credit balance although it is an asset, and the moving average is corrupted by every later purchase, so the cost of goods sold comes out wrong. inventorySettings.show_stock_quantities: Show total and available warehouse quantity for products
inventorySettings.show_stock_quantities_hint: When off, the quantity is hidden from the product list and the product card. This option affects no balance and no journal entry — display only.
inventorySettings.total_in_stock_hint: Determines how quantity is checked on sale or issue: total stock, or what is available after deducting reserved quantities. Not built yet — there is no concept of a reserved quantity in the system today, so total and available are one number.

inventorySettings.c_units_d: Define base units and conversion ratios so you can buy and sell products in different units.
inventorySettings.c_employee_warehouses_d: Assign default warehouses to employees to track their permissions, stock movements and permits.
inventorySettings.c_barcode_d: Set barcode preferences and formats for accurate scanning and weight-based pricing.
inventorySettings.c_fields_d: Add custom fields to capture extra data and show it on product pages, lists and reports.
inventorySettings.unit_base_hint: The stock unit — every quantity in the ledger is counted in it.

inventoryOpenings.title: Inventory opening balances
inventoryOpenings.subtitle: The zero point the perpetual inventory starts from. Recorded once per item, before it has any movement.
inventoryOpenings.import_subtitle: Upload a CSV or XLSX file, map its columns, review the check, then create a draft you post deliberately.
inventoryOpenings.export_demo_unavailable: Downloads are unavailable in preview mode. Sign in with a real account to download an actual file.
inventoryOpenings.drop_hint: Drop the file here, or choose it from your device.
inventoryOpenings.file_limits: CSV or XLSX · up to {rows} rows and {mb} MB.
inventoryOpenings.file_too_large: The file exceeds {limit} MB. Split it into smaller files.
inventoryOpenings.opening_date_hint: One date for the whole document — not a column per row. It dates the journal entry and every stock movement.
inventoryOpenings.allow_zero_cost_hint: A zero cost brings stock in with no value, which makes every margin report misleading. Enable it only when that is genuinely intended.
inventoryOpenings.zero_cost_on: Allowed — consent stored on the document
inventoryOpenings.mapping_hint: Map each column in your file to its AWJ field. The suggestion is automatic and editable; an unmapped column is ignored.
inventoryOpenings.mapping_duplicate: Two columns map to the same field. Pick a different field for one of them.
inventoryOpenings.mapping_missing_product: No column identifies the product. Map SKU, barcode or AWJ ID.
inventoryOpenings.mapping_missing_warehouse: No warehouse column. Map the warehouse code, name or ID.
inventoryOpenings.mapping_missing_required: The field “{field}” is required and is not mapped to any column.
inventoryOpenings.blocking_errors: {count} rows block creation. Fix them in the file and upload again.
inventoryOpenings.no_blocking_errors: No blocking errors — the file is ready.
inventoryOpenings.rows_truncated: Showing the first {shown} rows; the counters cover the whole file.
inventoryOpenings.confirm_hint: A draft document will be created with these lines. No stock movement and no journal entry until you post it.
inventoryOpenings.confirm_blocked: Creation is blocked while the file still has a blocking error.
inventoryOpenings.draft_next_step: Review the draft lines, then post it. Posting is what moves stock and creates the journal entry.
inventoryOpenings.posted_immutable: Posted document — not editable, not deletable. Correct it with a reversing entry.
